title.narrative: Financing Environmentally Sustainable Growth in Infrastructure Project

description.narrative: The $500 million financial intermediation loan (FIL) will support a shift toward more environmentally sustainable infrastructure development to meet India's climate change goals. It will address a gap in long-term financing for nonbank financial companies (NBFCs) and support green and sustainable infrastructure projects through India Infrastructure Finance Company Limited (IIFCL), a state-owned financial institution. ADB's support will also help to build the institutional capacity of IIFCL to integrate green technology and best practices into infrastructure projects.
